summary: The PR replaces Django's custom escape function with Python's stdlib html.escape(), improving performance but changing the escaping of single quotes.

issues.description: The change alters the escaping of single quotes from ' to ', which is a backward-incompatible change. While functionally equivalent, this could break applications relying on the specific output format.
The addition of a new test settings file (tests/test_settings.py) seems unnecessary and unrelated to the core change in django/utils/html.py.
The docstring in django/utils/html.py could be updated to reflect the change in behavior regarding single quotes.
